author: root

silhouette.reason: At native size the cap now has a shaped crown and separate brim, short rear hair reveals a nape, and the compact head/shoulder/dressed-hip masses form a balanced original hero. The earlier large dark rear wall and bib-like torso reading are reduced. These changes remain readable beside the actual reference silhouettes.

anatomy.reason: Front pupils consistently occupy x5/x10 on both eye rows; ears/cheeks, profile nose/chin, nape/collar and outlined limb roots remain anatomically connected. Shorter hair improves neck/shoulder separation. Profile facial and arm cloth planes are still relatively simple rather than as sculpted as the official reference protagonists.

walking.reason: All directions preserve genuine opposed arm/leg action, a grounded planted foot and compact swung foot. Near/far profile shoes retain distinct overlapping toe/heel shapes, and the gray cuff remains attached through the diagonal phase-B forearm gesture. Red/cream footwear accents belong to stable shoe clusters rather than floating pixels.

pixelCraft.reason: Connected red cap light/shadow planes, a short tapered rear hair cluster, diagonal tan/brown pack planes with a lower red pocket, and a coherent central shirt plane create clearer volume at 1x. Native clusters remain clean across all 12 poses. Some side face/cloth shaping is geometric, and cream outsole pixels are conspicuous at 4x, keeping this below a perfect craft score.

identity.reason: Red cap, blue vest with a light undershirt, and tan-gold/red pack now read as coherent shaped costume components, not isolated color labels or a striped plaque. Pocket placement and accessory attachment remain consistent through turns. The original design is still simpler than some reference protagonist outfits.

directionContinuity.reason: All four headings preserve proportions, costume and pack placement. Light/shadow clusters follow the pose consistently, with side treatments compatible with the reference sprite mirroring convention. Profile volume remains more stylized than the front/back masses.

loop.reason: All four decoded 140ms frames match the native stepA-idle-stepB-idle cycle in all directions; repeated idle is consistent and no unexplained root/garment jump or seam appears. All 16 pose comparisons and transparent gutters personally checked. Root browser record/screenshot show three native poses at 1x/4x with 14 samples each and no errors; no new live browser session is claimed by this critic.

reviewIndependence: Same-model organizational/task separation only; no different-model or decorrelated aesthetic independence is claimed.
nonblockingLimitations: Profile facial and arm-cloth planes remain simpler and more geometric than the official protagonist references.
The original vest/pack design remains comparatively simple despite its clearer coherent planes.
Cream outsole pixels are bright at 4x; they remain attached to stable footwear at native size.
decisionReason: 87 meets the unchanged 85 threshold, every axis minimum and zero critical failures. Native cap/hair silhouette and coherent shirt/pack identity changes support the higher silhouette/identity scores; no automatic increment was assigned for iteration number, test results or merely following suggested coordinates.
referenceMaterialPolicy: Nintendo reference crops and comparison stay external inspection material under /tmp; they are not game assets or intended public shipping evidence.
approvalScope: Only the reviewed native PNG/GIF bytes and prepared observation package. No canonical save/reload, runtime integration, authenticated independence or user acceptance is asserted.
scope: Read-only source/art/store inspection plus the requested formal review and temporary comparison artifacts.
